newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a strong buy.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley said in a report that it has reiterated its strong buy rating on Brazilian federal telecommunications giant Telebras.
-- The brokerage cited Tuesday's sale of a strategic stake in Rio Grande do Sul state telecom CRT for 681 million reais, or 54.8 percent above the base price.
-- "We believe that yesterday's sale of 35 percent of the voting capital in CRT...is an extremely positive development for Telebras and its operating subsidiaries," it said.
-- "This sale establishes a much higher valuation benchmark for Brazilian telecom companies," it added.
-- CRT was the first Brazilian company to be opened up to private capital and its purchase price was 2.5 times Telebras' current per-line valuation, Morgan Stanley said.
-- It added that, based on the CRT sale, Telebras and its units should rise in price to reflect the new benchmark as their privatizations near.
-- Telebras' ADR was up 1-1/4 at 76-5/8 in New York, while its preferred share rose 1.79 percent to 79.90 reais and its voting common advanced 1.54 percent to 72.60 reais in Sao Paulo.
